notes:
# The background helper can be restarted {gearshape}
Settings > General > Background helper has a Restart button. It is the
one thing that rescues a helper macOS is still holding but which has
stopped doing its rounds -- switching phone remote off and on could not,
because re-installing a job launchd already has changes nothing. A Mac in
that state looks perfectly healthy and cannot be reached by a phone.

---

Everything else in this release:

- A licensed Mac is no longer offered an Upgrade button in the title bar.
- Clearing the notes question from your phone now clears it on the Mac.
  It was being written back over by the words still on the Mac's screen.
- Turning phone remote on restarts the helper, so it takes effect at once
  rather than on the helper's next round.
